# ragdoll_vnext
kind: short
base: ragdoll_short
captions: pop
# Voice text verbatim from ragdoll_vnext/cut.py; shot notes reconstructed from the clips v1 cut on each line.

L1 "The death animation in my game was really bad." {old death animation: sniper POV in hell, a runner gets shot and does the old stiff death}
M2 {no voice: the old grey death, same as before}
L3 "Yeaeeeeeeeh I needed something better, but if my art didnt make it clear, I'm a programmer, not an animator" {slow zoom out from the old hell pit}
L4 "Luckily my solution actually came from you guys, in an earlier short when i asked for suggestions, this guy gave me the exact solution to my problem. Ragdolls"
  {sniper POV from the tower, a runner is shot and ragdolls with momentum, the hit lands on "Ragdolls"; comment card: @commenter "try ragdolls"}
L5 "these are pretty janky, but im keeping it that way, because it doesnt effect gameplay, and i think makes it more entertaining" {sniper hits on several runners, each one ragdolls, then a mild freakout flight}
L6 "Once i had this, i wanted to use it more. Now when you shove someone, they also ragdoll." {melee shove, the victim ragdolls; then runner POV face shove}
L7 "And when you reach the tower, you can shove the guard out, and watch them go flying into the pit." {runner POV finale: reach the tower, shove the guard out, he flies into the pit}
L8 "Let me know what else I should add in the comments" {same shot as L7 continues}
